comparator_authority: Deterministic RedQualificationComparator over (QualifiedRedExpectation, RedObservation) is the sole producer of authoritative failure_reason_matches_intended_defect. First-slice rule EXACT_FAILED_TEST_IDS with full conjunction (qualified status, authoritative source, revision equality, fingerprint equality, exit 1/1, TEST_FAILURE kind, non-empty exact ID set equality).
evidence_seal_rule: Comparator evidence is sealed with the run envelope (red_qualification key) and projected into the same-run receipt (to_dict) and runtime result under one qualification identity; no replay or recompute.
observation_authority: Actual pre-mutation verifier run through canonical run_controlled under the run's own WorkContract (tool/cwd/risk/issuer gating); failed IDs parsed from the authoritative command receipt stdout only.
workcontract_binding_rule: First-slice WorkContracts carry red_policy RED_REQUIRED plus an optional red_expectation binding {expectation_id, expectation_version, expectation_ref, expectation_sha256}. The runtime re-reads the staged file and denies on any identity/bytes/ref mismatch; unbound staged files never authorize; cross-WorkContract reuse denied.
